title: Simultaneous componentwise K-flat representatives
statement:
For every complex K of strict systems over B, there is a quasi-isomorphism P→K of strict system complexes such that every evaluated complex P_n is independently K-flat over B_n and has flat terms. Evaluation of a K-flat flat-term module complex on the ringed sequence site has these properties at every level.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w})
theorem strictRingSystem_kFlatResolution (K : CochainComplex (StrictRingSystem B) ℤ) :
    ∃ (L : CochainComplex (StrictRingSystem B) ℤ) (f : L ⟶ K),
      systemComponentwiseKFlat B L ∧ QuasiIso f
```

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, ordinary evaluation left extension and the subsequence generalization; Stacks 03DA, 03DB, 06YT and 07D9

proof.text: Construct evaluation as the inverse image of the geometric morphism of the sequence site, with identity structural ring map. Apply the existing ringed-topos K-flat and flat-term pullback theorem. Resolve the module complex on the single ringed sequence site by a flat-term K-flat complex, then transport the augmentation and its quasi-isomorphism back along the explicit strict-system/module equivalence. Exactness of the equivalence and all evaluations gives the simultaneous property.
